{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel values in customer_age:", sales_df['customer_age'].isin([-1]).sum())

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
print("Channel distribution:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if there are any rows with missing values
print("Missing values:\n", sales_df.isnull().sum())"}
